name: List fields a segment can filter on
description: List contact attributes and system fields that can be used in a segment filter, with the data type of each. Use before building fe_query so the field and operator are valid.

dataType.description: Observed: email, text, category, date, boolean, list, flagged, last_modified, entered. Subscription filters use dataType 'subscription_status' (field email_blacklisted, operator subscribed), which this endpoint does not list.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page. Free account returned 24 fields. Operators per data type were not enumerated.
